_doc: Lines shown in the app without an app release (app/src/shared/announcements.ts has the format). Publish with node curator/publish-catalog.ts --push; apps from 0.4.9 on show them within two hours. A changed text needs a new id (dismissed ids stay hidden). Bump 'updated' with every change.

items.text: Stellaris 4.6 update coming soon! The mods are being checked against 4.6 while their authors update them – until then the app supports 4.5.4.
